rules.accepted_credit_types: CE from providers approved by KBN, another state board of nursing, or a national nursing organization listed in 201 KAR 20:220 (e.g. ANCC, AANP, AACN, NAPNES, NALPN); BLS/CPR not accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: One-time topic courses are due within 3 years of initial licensure.
rules.alternatives: Instead of 14 hours: 7 hours plus a satisfactory employment evaluation covering 6+ months; a current national nursing certification; a post-licensure academic nursing course (grade C or Pass); 120+ hours as a preceptor; a peer-reviewed nursing article; or presenting an approved nursing CE course.
rules.audit_note: Annual random CE audit announced in November via the KBN Nurse Portal; keep CE records 5 years.

topics.who: nurses licensed by July 15, 2024 must finish by Oct 31, 2027; later licensees within 3 years of initial licensure
out-of-state graduates or Kentucky program graduates before Aug 2025; within 3 years of licensure
out-of-state graduates or Kentucky program graduates before May 1988; within 3 years of licensure
pediatric abusive head trauma; out-of-state graduates or Kentucky program graduates before Dec 2011; within 3 years of licensure

rules.notes: Annual earning and renewal period Nov 1 - Oct 31; renewal window Sept 15 - Oct 31. Uploading CE to the portal is optional unless audited.
rules.rule_quote: Section 3. Methods for continued competency validation as established in subsection (1) through (4) of this section shall be: (1) Fourteen (14) contact hours of continuing education, which shall: (a) Be from a provider approved by the board pursuant to 201 KAR 20:220; (b) Be completed during the earning period;…
